title: The Fan-Bearer's Primer
summary: Teaches the folded grip and the first guard and thrust of the war fan step by step to complete beginners.

title: First Lessons in the Folded Fan
summary: Teaches new recruits to swing and block with the shut fan before any opened leaf work begins.

title: A Handbook of Wrist and Rib
summary: Teaches wrist rolls and rib cuts of the half-open fan to students who already carry a muscled arm.

title: The Iron-Ribbed Fan Drill-Book
summary: Teaches heavy iron-ribbed fan blocks chops and locks for drill yards where the fan is used as a short club.

title: Opening and Closing the War Fan
summary: Teaches the quick opening and shutting of the war fan as both guard and strike for trained bodies.

title: Workbook of the Fan Guard
summary: Teaches first qi-backed guards of the opened fan to students who have just begun to circulate qi.

title: Plain Rules for Fan and Footwork
summary: Teaches how the feet and the fan work together in short cuts slips and feints for new circulators.

title: The Leaf-Edge Handbook
summary: Teaches cuts and catches with the sharpened edge of the opened leaf to students who can circulate qi.

title: Short Course on the Spread Fan
summary: Teaches the fully spread fan as chest guard and sweeping edge in a short course for early cultivators.

title: A Treatise on Fan Parries
summary: Sets out the high and low parries of the war fan and the counters that follow each one.

title: Fan Canon of the Closed Rib
summary: Teaches the shut fan used like a short staff for guarding jabbing and hooking by trained circulators.
